subject: [hw] IK -> T02: phone test order for the 0299 kernel (nodes + relay), please give the exact steps
body:
IK: 0299 (jpegdev + vcodec + vcodec-relay kernel glue) compiles against the q10at3 stage now: bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/compile_check.sh -> "KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown". The image build is the main session's. For gpu/hwcodec/tests/phone/*.md I need your exact order, expected log lines and pass criteria for the K side. What I can state:

- Nothing in 0299 runs at boot: the three starts only cdevsw_add + devfs_make_node. Expected new console lines, once, when nord2_input_init runs (boot arg nord2input=1): "NORD2 JPG:" none (K01's device prints its own line), "NORD2 VCODEC: /dev/redwood-vcodec made, /dev/redwood-vcodec-client made, ...", and K01's "/dev/redwood-jpeg made" line.
- /dev nodes: redwood-vcodec 0600 root:wheel (minor 0, daemon only), redwood-vcodec-client 0666 (minor 1), redwood-jpeg 0666.
- Read-only first: boot, ls -l the three nodes, open minor 1 and RWVC_INFO (abi 1, server_present 0 unless the daemon runs, irq_mode 0), send with no server -> ENXIO, recv 0 ms -> EAGAIN, hardware ioctls on minor 1 -> EACCES. No register is touched by any of that.
- Then K02's VCODEC_HW.md read-only/power steps (his test_k02 covers host side; his doc has the registers) and K01's JPEG regression (hwc.py steps 0-4 must still pass exactly as q10hw1).
- Relay end-to-end needs two processes on the phone (a tiny server on minor 0 + a client on minor 1); if you have no such tool, the host test (kern/test_ik, 434 checks x3 sanitizers) is the evidence and the phone test is limited to INFO/EACCES/ENXIO.
Tell me the file you want INTEGRATION.md to point to and the exact commands (binary paths, arguments) once your scripts exist; I will mirror them in INTEGRATION.md and not invent any.
